question: Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL) was incorporated in the year _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1967.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL) **was incorporated on** November 9, 1967**.
 
• It is a **public sector** undertaking under the administrative control of the** Ministry of Mines,** Government of India.
 
• HCL is involved in **exploration, mining, beneficiation, smelting, refining and casting of refined copper metal.** It is India's only vertically integrated copper producer and is involved in a wide spectrum of activities in the metal sector.
 
• HCL's mines and plants are spread across four operating units, namely: **Khetri Copper Complex in Rajasthan, Indian Copper Complex in Jharkhand, Malanjkhand Copper Project in Madhya Pradesh, and Taloja Copper Project in Maharashtra.**
 
• It is also responsible for contributing to the supply of copper products, like copper cathodes, continuous cast copper rods, and other by products, such as **gold, silver, and sulphuric acid,** to the Indian market.
 
• In the recent years, HCL has been focusing on increasing its production capacity and upgrading its older mines and plants, demonstrating its commitment to the development of the nation's copper industry.
 
• As a leading copper manufacturer in the country, HCL plays a significant role in **India's metal industry, **influencing the country's industrial growth and contributing significantly to the nation's economy.
